name: Repository Capability Discovery
description: Implement a discovery system that determines what a repository can do: build, test, lint, format, deploy, typecheck, generate docs, etc. Read repository structure (package.json, Makefile, Dockerfile, CI configs) to infer capabilities. Expose capabilities as a structured queryable set. Support user-supplied overrides and declarations.
purpose: Tribunus needs to know what actions are available for each repository to offer contextual tooling. Capability discovery eliminates manual configuration — the system learns what a repo can do by reading its configuration files, conventions, and history.
acceptanceCriteria: Capabilities are inferred from repository structure: package.json scripts, Makefile targets, Dockerfile presence, CI configs, etc.
Discovered capabilities include: build, test, lint, format, typecheck, deploy, generate-docs, generate-types, generate-schemas
Capabilities are queryable via API and CLI
Users can declare capabilities explicitly (override auto-detection)
Capability discovery runs on repository attachment and on workspace events (git pull, branch switch)
Capability results are cached and invalidated on relevant file changes
Unknown/unrecognized capabilities are reported as 'unknown' rather than guessed
